class_notes.person: The astronaut. COCO 'person' is a reliable proposal source; confirm/edit by hand.
class_notes.main_experiment_box: The large container the red/yellow boxes start inside. NOT auto-proposed (section 6): no reliable visual heuristic is known yet.
class_notes.red_box: The small red box. A saturated-red HSV heuristic proposes candidates, but it also fires on skin and clothing, so every box needs human confirmation.
class_notes.yellow_box: The small yellow box. Same caveat as red_box: a saturated-yellow HSV heuristic proposes candidates only.
class_notes.red_target_area: Where the red box must end up. NOT auto-proposed (section 6). It is a placement REGION, so a drawn box is an operator judgement about the acceptable landing area, not a detected object.
class_notes.yellow_target_area: Where the yellow box must end up. NOT auto-proposed (section 6).

excluded_classes.opened_box: A state, not an object. Derived temporally from main_experiment_box + content motion later.
excluded_classes.held_red_box: A state. Derived from hand overlap + object motion; putting it in the detector would force the model to guess action from a single frame.
excluded_classes.held_yellow_box: A state, same reasoning as held_red_box.
excluded_classes.PICK_RED / PLACE_RED / PICK_YELLOW / PLA: Actions. Never YOLO classes (section 5): the model answers WHAT is visible and WHERE, temporal logic answers WHAT is happening.
